# Roadmap: Manual QA / Test Engineer

## Role overview

Tests software by hand to find bugs before users do.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)
- [ ] [Testing](../topics/testing.md)

## Also needed

STLC, Test case design, Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Postman

## Where it leads

Grow: Automation Test Engineer (SDET) · Lead: Scrum Master / Agile Coach, Project Manager · Pivot: Business Analyst (BA), AI Evaluation (Evals) Engineer, Performance Test Engineer
